meta.name: add-whatsapp
meta.description: Add WhatsApp channel via native Baileys adapter. Direct connection — no Chat SDK bridge. Uses QR code or pairing code for authentication.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 接入 WhatsApp 渠道,直接收发消息
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你正在开发需要与 WhatsApp 收发消息的应用或机器人.
copy.tagline_en: Connect WhatsApp channel for direct messaging
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're building an app or bot that needs to send and receive WhatsApp messages.

howto.what: 它把 WhatsApp 接成 NanoClaw 的一个渠道：从 channels 分支拷入原生 Baileys 适配器并注册、安装固定版本依赖、跑构建和注册测试，最后用二维码或配对码把 WhatsApp 登录上去。
howto.when: 当你想给 NanoClaw 添加 WhatsApp 渠道时触发。它先做号码安全确认（专用号还是个人号），再问用二维码还是配对码登录。

say.text: 帮我把 WhatsApp 加到 NanoClaw 里
say.note: 会先问用哪个号码、再选登录方式

say.text: 我用专用号码，登录方式选二维码
say.note: 走专用号安装，终端显示二维码

say.text: 我用的是个人号，先把风险提示给我看
say.note: 显示账号风险警告并要求确认

howto.what_en: Installs a native Baileys WhatsApp adapter into the project: copies it from the channels branch, registers it, installs pinned packages, builds and runs the registration test, then links WhatsApp by QR code or pairing code.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you want to add a WhatsApp channel. It first runs the number safety check, then asks whether to link with a QR code or a pairing code.

say_en.text: Add WhatsApp to NanoClaw for me
say_en.note: Asks which number to use, then how to link

say_en.text: Use a dedicated number, link with a QR code
say_en.note: Shows a QR code in the terminal to scan

say_en.text: I use my personal number, show the risk warning
say_en.note: Shows the account-risk warning and asks to confirm
